children: Overview
Germany investment company's H1 2026 revenue grew yr/yr, but net loss replaced prior net income
Net Asset Value rose to EUR 43.96 mln, driven by capital increase and portfolio expansion
Company's Defense Tech portfolio expansion and partnerships seen as key drivers for future value
Outlook
Company to focus on further investments in Defense Tech and dual-use technologies in H2 2026
Objective remains to sustainably increase Net Asset Value and create long-term value for shareholders
Company sees significant additional value appreciation potential in Defense Tech portfolio
Result Drivers
DEFENSE TECH FOCUS - Co said expansion and operational progress in Defense Tech and dual-use technologies drove portfolio value growth
DESTINUS PARTNERSHIPS - Destinus benefited from industrial partnerships and technological expansion, including a joint venture with Rheinmetall and acquisition of Swiss AI specialist Daedalean
CAPITAL INCREASE - May 2026 capital increase provided resources for further portfolio expansion
